# SWYMBLE

> Swymble is a one-person software studio and engineering lab based in Kuala
> Lumpur, Malaysia. It builds websites, apps and AI systems for businesses as
> client work, and develops its own experimental products under the name
> Swymble Labs.

Swymble is both a personal engineering brand and a small studio. The engineer
behind it builds backend systems, APIs and AI platforms professionally —
mostly on enterprise fintech platforms — and applies the same discipline to
client projects and to independent products.

## Key pages

- https://swymble.com/ : The software studio and personal lab of a fintech grade engineer: client products, shipped projects, experiments, and the stories behind them.
- https://swymble.com/projects : Websites, apps, and product builds shipped by SWYMBLE: client work and personal products, with the thinking behind each one.
- https://swymble.com/labs : See SWYMBLE Labs experiments across AI, product R&D, prototypes, and in-progress ideas.
- https://swymble.com/about : The engineer behind SWYMBLE: enterprise fintech experience, a one-person studio for client work, and a lab of personal builds and experiments.
- https://swymble.com/resume : One-page resume: fintech platform engineering, a solo studio shipping client work, selected products, education and the full stack behind them.
- https://swymble.com/blog : Read SWYMBLE notes on software engineering, AI systems, builds, lessons learned, and ideas worth documenting.
- https://swymble.com/contact : Start a project with SWYMBLE. Tell me what you want to build and I will get back to you within 24 hours.

## Swymble Labs projects

Each lab has its own page with a full description, and several are live
products anyone can use today.

- https://swymble.com/labs/cortex : Cortex is a Swymble Labs AI platform built around persistent long-context memory and operator decision support for complex digital workflows.
- https://swymble.com/labs/mybirth : MyBirth is a free web app that rebuilds the day you were born — moon phase, weather, headlines, music and film — as a shareable keepsake archive.
- https://swymble.com/labs/mydompet : MyDompet is an offline-first money tracker for Android and iOS that keeps every transaction in SQLite on your own phone, with no account server.
- https://swymble.com/labs/what2watch : what2watch is a free Swymble Labs web app that packs tens of thousands of movies and shows into one interactive voronoi wall you can browse by mood.
- https://swymble.com/labs/watchpaintdry : Watch Paint Dry is a free browser toy: a wall of fresh paint, a timer counting how long you stare at it, and achievements for your patience.
- https://swymble.com/labs/territory : Territory is a fitness gamification app from Swymble Labs that turns real-world movement into claimable territory on a virtual map.

## Client projects

- IB Solutions (IB Solutions (M)): I designed and built IB Solutions company profile from the ground up. They are a Malaysian professional services company specialising in corporate training and capability development. Live at https://ibsolutions.com.my.
